raw_evidence: /mnt/project-files/evals-cache/f15-ocr/ (ref/ reference outputs, captures and network logs; out/ our outputs, one HAR and Lighthouse JSON; shots/; scripts/). Not in git.
harness: Playwright headless Chromium, 1280x632; 390x664 by resizing the same session. Result read by polling the result frame every 25 ms.

input.pages: 3: an upright scanned picture (1240x1754 JPEG), a typed page, a scanned picture on a page with a 90 degree turn

flow: Choosing the file uploads it at once (two POSTs: an upload check, then the upload, about 0.8 s after choosing). Pages are then shown one under the other.

Options: a language list of 61 entries (one per run; Arabic is not in it), output format ticks PDF (on) and Text (off), a tick to replace text from a previous OCR (off), and a per-page quick mode with its own language list and button beside each page.
Stated free limits: 10 pages or 50 MB per task, 3 tasks per hour. No sign-in or payment was asked for.
Result opens in an overlay frame: Download, Back to editing, Start over, Delete files.

task1.settings: English, PDF only, replace tick off, 1280 wide

task2.settings: English, PDF and Text, replace tick off, 390 wide
task2.zip_holds: a PDF of 72,578 B and a text file of 339 B, 60 words, all correct

output_observations: Words exact on all three pages; the typed page is not doubled.

Text layer: invisible, one run per word with a trailing space and a horizontal scale. Word box left edge within 0.16-0.24 pt of the ink (median), right edge 5.1-5.7 pt short (median). Same geometry as ours.
Both picture streams byte-identical to the source; render difference 0 on every page; page sizes and the 90 degree turn kept; qpdf check clean.
72,578 B from 67,092 B (+8.2%): the same byte count as ours, a different file.
reference.phone_390: Sideways scroll: document 482 px wide on landing and 457 px with a file in. The per-page button runs past the right edge. Run button at y=604 of 664; result Download at y=244.
reference.not_captured: Per-page quick mode run; replace-previous-OCR tick on; a non-English run; a file over 10 pages; error states; a noisy or photographed scan.
